name: power-plan
title: Power Plan
description: Switch Windows power plans and change them automatically while you play games
author: mendyka

commands.name: power-plans
commands.title: Power Plans
commands.description: Show and switch power plans, choose the plans for gaming and idle, control automatic switching

commands.name: game-detection
commands.title: Game Detection
commands.description: See which running programs count as games and adjust the rules

commands.name: auto
commands.title: Automatic Power Plan
commands.subtitle: Power Plan
commands.description: Runs in the background: game running → gaming plan, otherwise → idle plan. Enable it via the command's background refresh setting.

preferences.name: cooldown
preferences.title: Switch Back After (s)
preferences.description: Seconds to wait after the last game closed before switching to the idle plan

preferences.name: notificationStyle
preferences.title: Notify on Switch
preferences.description: Show a message when the plan changes automatically

preferences.name: enforce
preferences.title: Other Programs
preferences.label: Restore the automatic plan when something else changes it
preferences.description: On (recommended): if a game or tool switches the plan, it is restored within about 10 seconds. To pick a plan yourself, activate it in “Power Plans” (pauses the automation for 1 hour) or pause the automation.

commands.name: toggle-auto
commands.title: Toggle Automatic Power Plan
commands.description: Turn automatic power plan switching on or off

preferences.name: detectFullscreen
preferences.title: Game Detection
preferences.label: Treat fullscreen apps as games
preferences.description: Also count any fullscreen app in the foreground as a game (browsers and video players are ignored)

preferences.name: extraLibraries
preferences.title: Additional Game Folders
preferences.description: Folders whose programs count as games, separated by ; (e.g. D:\Games). Steam, Epic, GOG, Xbox, Ubisoft, EA, Riot, Battle.net and Amazon libraries are detected automatically.
